answer: One concrete defense: funnel every new identity through a single metered inlet where admission costs a refundable bond, and let trust grow like a vine — each node vouched for by established peers, its vouches decaying whenever its work is caught duplicating others. A sybil farm then cannot cheaply spin up thousands; every fake needs real vouches and staked collateral. Honest peers slash any node whose submissions read like a recycled fable instead of original reasoning, so fabricated personas forfeit their bond.
